needed.evidence: No continuous purpose-built sidewalk; people and a parked van occupy the edge of the carriageway.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous 1.5 m concrete footway along the left side, set back from the parked van.

needed.evidence: Market stalls, umbrellas and goods occupy the entire right edge, leaving no usable footway.
needed.suggestion: Provide a 1.5 m footway on the right, relocating the market to a designated area behind it.

needed.evidence: Stalls, crates and umbrellas completely block the right edge.
needed.suggestion: Clear the right edge of stalls and goods to restore a clear pedestrian route.

needed.evidence: Uneven, broken paving and debris at the road edge.
needed.suggestion: Re-lay the left edge with a smooth, level surface to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: Crates, boxes and uneven ground create major trip hazards.
needed.suggestion: Level and clear the right edge, removing crates and debris.

needed.evidence: High crossing demand from shops and market on both sides, but no marked or purpose-built crossing.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with high-visibility paint at the market frontage.

needed.evidence: No street lights are visible along this urban street.
needed.suggestion: Install LED street lights at 30 m intervals along both sides of the road.
